log_file.description: Path to the log file for the instance monitor service.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

use_syslog.description: Enable logging to syslog instead of files.

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging via syslog.

log_level.description: Logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

transport_url.description: Message bus connection URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or other messaging backends).

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for service user.

project_name.description: Keystone project name for Masakari service user.

user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for service user.

username.description: Username for Masakari service in Keystone.

password.description: Password for Masakari service user in Keystone. *Do not store in plaintext in production.*

segment_heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeats sent by the instance monitor to signal liveness.

notification_driver.description: Notification driver to use for sending events.

instance_monitor_enabled.description: Enable monitoring of virtual instance health.

instance_monitor_retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait before retrying instance health check after failure.

instance_monitor_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries before declaring instance unhealthy.

auto_recover.description: Automatically recover failed instances via evacuation or restart.

recover_method.description: Recovery method: 'auto' (automatic evacuation or restart), 'stop', 'restart', or 'evacuate'.

notification_endpoint.description: Optional endpoint to send additional notifications (e.g., webhook URL).

health_check_uri.description: HTTP(S) URI to use for health check of instances (optional).

hosts.description: List of host-specific monitoring configurations. Each entry defines a host to be monitored with custom settings.

name.description: Hostname or FQDN to match in this segment.

enabled.description: Whether monitoring is enabled for this host.

segment_id.description: UUID of the Masakari segment this host belongs to.

monitoring_uri.description: Optional custom URI used for health monitoring of this host (e.g., SSH, HTTP).
